From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brighton-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time to chat earlier today — really enjoyed learning about Brighton Analytics' plans for scaling document ingestion and semantic search across teams. Quick recap and the next steps we agreed on: 

- What we heard: you need sub-150ms median query latency for search, retention of 12 months of embeddings, and tighter cost predictability for peak hours.
- Success metric: 90% of queries under 200ms during your 9am-6pm window; cost target ~20% below current spend.
- Proposed POC: small sandbox with 2 endpoints (search + rerank), ~1M monthly tokens, sample dataset of product docs + support tickets.
- Next steps we agreed:
  1) Redwood provides POC plan and cost estimate by Tue 3/12 (attached)
  2) Brighton to share sample dataset + security questionnaire answers
  3) Schedule 60-min technical kickoff with your infra/SE on Wed 3/17 or Thu 3/18

Attachments: Discovery-Notes-Brighton-Analytics.pdf (notes & POC outline)

If that matches your notes, I can send calendar invites for the kickoff. If timelines shifted on your side, please let me know — happy to adjust.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
